name: Curtiss-Wright Corporation

investment_theses.company_type: Nuclear Pumps & Valves / SMR Supply Chain

content: Curtiss-Wright Corporation is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace and defense markets, as well as critical technologies in demanding commercial power, process, and industrial markets. Leveraging a heritage of innovation, the company operates through three segments: Aerospace & Industrial, Defense Electronics, and Naval & Power. It is a leading supplier of high-tech components for nuclear power plants and naval propulsion systems, and it plays a vital role in the global supply chain for small modular reactors (SMRs) and advanced defense electronics.

Officers

Lynn M. Bamford(Date: 2022 May)

Chair of the Board

Ms. Bamford has served as Chair of the Board of Directors since May 2022 and Chief Executive Officer since January 2021. She previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer from January 2020 to January 2021. She has been with the Company since 2004.

K. Christopher Farkas(Date: 2021 May)

Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Farkas has served as Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since May 2021. He previously served as Vice President and Corporate Controller from 2014 to 2021.

Paul J. Ferdenzi(Date: 2011 January)

Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary

Mr. Ferdenzi has served as Vice President, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary since 2011. He has been with the Company since 1999.
